title: TherapeuticAI® | Connect a Child’s Goal to Guided Therapy
software: PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 · Class B non-diagnostic developmental-support software · licensed for children aged 0–12
directAnswer: The BIS schedule describes Everyday Therapy delivered through TherapeuticAI and an adaptive therapy-plan support function. Professional assessment and family priorities determine what is suitable. The software supports selection, delivery and tracking; it does not independently prescribe treatment.
lifePurpose: Speech, occupational, behavioural and educational contributions may each be useful when they serve a particular child’s daily participation; no fixed combination is assumed.

illustrativeExample.title: From requesting help to joining play.
illustrativeExample.description: Illustrative example only. A child wants help opening a play box so a shared game can begin.

steps.title: Name the life moment
steps.description: The child’s wish to join play gives the activity its purpose.

steps.title: Select with judgement
steps.description: A relevant professional chooses an accessible communication or motor support and checks comfort and preference.

steps.title: Practise with meaning
steps.description: The technique is used in the session and an agreed natural moment, rather than repeated for a score alone.

steps.title: Review response
steps.description: Family and therapist discuss what the child used, what support remained and whether to adapt.

illustrativeExample.status: Fictional explanatory example; not a patient story or observed result.

mechanism: A real-life goal determines what ability matters.
Qualified professionals select appropriate support and coordinate with family and other disciplines as relevant.
Observed response returns through Fusion and later reassessment.
limit: A BIS licence and module name do not certify an individual therapist, establish treatment effectiveness or mean every therapy is appropriate for every child.

questions.question: Does TherapeuticAI replace my child’s therapist?
questions.answer: No. It supports a professionally selected, family-informed plan; clinicians and families remain responsible for care decisions.

questions.question: Must my child receive speech, occupational, ABA and special education together?
questions.answer: No. Suitable disciplines and activities depend on assessment, family priorities and the child’s needs.

questions.question: Does the BIS record prove an activity will work?
questions.answer: No. It documents the product and quality-system scope, not an individual clinical result.
